name: Chemdawg D
summary: Chemdawg D is a [[kind:cut|cut]] that Chemdog selected in 2001, when he germinated three more of the original 1991 [[chemdawg|Chemdawg]] seeds, labeled C, D, and E. D was the keeper of that round. It is a sibling of Chem 91 rather than its offspring.

sources.title: 25 Years of Chem Dog
sources.note: Planner-verified 2026-09-24: confirms the 2001 germination of seeds C, D, and E, with D as the keeper.
